I. 6 P. (खिन्दति, खिन्न) To strike, press down, afflict. --II. 4, 7. Ā. (खिद्यते, खिन्त्ते, खिन्न) To suffer pain or misery, to be afflicted or wearied, feel tired, depressed or exhausted; [[Ś. 5. 7]]; स पुरुषो यः खिद्यते नेन्द्रियैः [[H. 2. 130]]; overpowered; किं नाम मयि खिद्यते गुरु [[Ve. 1]]; [[Śānti. 3. 7]]; [[Bk. 14. 108]], 17. 10. -Caus. 
__1 To frighten, terrify. 
__2 To exhaust, fatigue, make tired; ममानिमित्तानि हि खेदयन्ति [[Mk. 9. 10.]]

__1 An ascetic. 
__2 A pauper. 
__3 The moon. 
__4 An epithet of Indra.

[खिद् दैन्ये रक्] 
__1 A poor man, a pauper. 
__2 Disease, sickness.
